name: H3 PTD per-step adapters (WAS)
plain: Applies a Parametric Trajectory Distillation file so H3 samples in 4 to 8 steps. Instead of one LoRA, each sampler step gets its own low-rank updates, added at run time to the layer outputs, and on Ref2VA files its own head pair. The node also outputs the sigmas the file was trained at, and sampling on other sigmas raises an error.
math:
hop = index of the trained knot within tolerance (5e-3, or a quarter of the smallest gap); off-grid uses the interval holding σ.
layer out ← out + scale·U_hop·D_hop·x, per step; fused fc2 is reapplied after its activation.
Ref2VA: final_layer.video_out and audio_out are swapped for the staged head bank of this hop, then restored.
fl2va: t = min(knot, 0.999), video shift forced to 1, audio shift from t, audio output × rate(t):
  σ_a = r·t·T/(T+(r−1)·t), rate = r·T²/(T+(r−1)·t)², r=0.25, T=0.999.

props.hook: set_injections + OUTER_SAMPLE (schedule check) + APPLY_MODEL (staging) + DIFFUSION_MODEL wrappers
props.architectures: H3 Ref2VA or fl2va transformer matching the file; bf16 or int8 files
